conf.description: Proofpoint TAP SIEM API message events, syslog-kv (format=syslog fallback): hand-built RFC 5424 SD parser per recommendations.direct.cribl since the stock proofpoint_tap pipelines expect JSON. Un-flattens the indexed threatsInfoMap/messageParts SD-PARAMs back into arrays and branches the condemned artifact by threatType before renaming the flat fields.

conf.comment: Proofpoint TAP message events via SIEM API syslog form (RFC 5424, [tapmsg@21139 ...] SD block). Field homes match the JSON api-pull dataset per the work order. Un-flattens threatsInfoMap.N.* and messageParts.N.* using code (bracket delete works on any literal key, unlike rename/eval.remove).

functions.description: why this pipeline exists and how it differs from the JSON path
isolate the tapmsg@21139 structured-data blob from the RFC 5424 header and any other SD elements
parse the SD-PARAM key="value" pairs, including the indexed threatsInfoMap.N.* / messageParts.N.* keys, into flat fields
convert the four numeric-looking score strings (phishScore, malwareScore, spamScore, impostorScore) to numbers

parts[0] : parts; __e['email'] = __e['email'] || {}; __e['email']['attachments'] = __e['email']['attachments'] || {}; __e['email']['attachments']['file'] = __e['email']['attachments']['file'] || {}; __e['email']['attachments']['file']['hash'] = __e['email']['attachments']['file']['hash'] || {}; __e['email']['attachments']['file']['hash']['sha256'] = sha; __e['file'] = __e['file'] || {}; __e['file']['hash'] = __e['file']['hash'] || {}; if (!__e['file']['hash']['sha256']) { __e['file']['hash']['sha256'] = sha; } } for (i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) { k = keys[i]; if (/^threatsInfoMap\.\d+\./.test(k) || /^messageParts\.\d+\./.test(k)) { delete __e[k]; } }

functions.description: un-flatten the indexed threatsInfoMap/messageParts SD-PARAMs into proofpoint_tap.message.threat[] and email.attachments.file.hash.sha256, branch the condemned artifact onto file.hash.sha256/url.original/email.from.address by threatType, then delete the now-redundant flattened keys (numeric-segment names have no rename/eval.remove path per the brief, but a literal bracket delete works)
set _time from the message delivery timestamp, read from the ORIGINAL flat field before it is renamed
batch rename the flat, clean-identifier SD-PARAM fields to their ECS or proofpoint_tap.* custom homes
tag the ECS data-stream dataset component (no hyphen, per constraint 5)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
